title: Doozy Vape Co Seriously Pod Fill MAX Blue Razz Breeze Shortfill - 40ml
description: Blue Razz Breeze from the Doozy Seriously Pod Fill Max collection of versatile 40ml shortfills is a Nicotine-Free E-liquid featuring Blue Raspberry and Menthol flavours, contained in a 40ml volume within a 60ml shortfill bottle. This e-liquid is designed to allow for fine-tuning your bottle’s nicotine strength, offering space to add up to two 10ml nicotine shots ( sold separately .) The 50VG/50PG ratio of this e-liquid makes it ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping devices, including Vape Starter Kits and Pod Kits that are compatible with high-resistance coils (0.8ohm+). The 50%/50% composition ensures a balanced sensation of flavour and vapour production. Upon adding one 10ml nic shot, users can achieve an approximate nicotine strength of 3 to 4mg, while using two nic shots can increase the strength to about 6 to 7mg, according to personal preference. Doozy Vape Co, established in 2015, has gained recognition for producing high-quality e-liquids. Their Seriously Pod Fill Max range offers a more intense burst of flavour, similar to what you might experience with disposable vapes. This makes Pod Fill Max e-liquids a great choice for fans of disposables who want the same pronounced flavours, but want to explore refillable, reusable MTL vape kits, all while having total control over their nicotine strengths.
